office: the Philippine Statistics Authority (PhilSys registration centres)

routes.label: registration in person at a PhilSys registration centre

note: For citizens. The Philippine Identification System Act (Republic Act 11055), section 6(c)(3): the first PhilID and its renewal are free to a citizen; a replacement card carries a standard fee (not modelled). The card's term and the time to delivery aren't in the act and the PSA's and PhilSys's own pages refused or were down this session, so both are null and the player is told.

sources.title: The LawPhil Project, Republic Act No. 11055 (Philippine Identification System Act), section 6
sources.said: The initial application and issuance as well as the renewal of the PhilID for citizens shall be free of charge.
